plain_definition: HKMA's collected set of numbered modules setting out its supervisory approach, policies, and the standards it expects Authorized Institutions to meet -- covering topics from corporate governance to, increasingly, cryptoasset-related risk. Each module has a short code, such as CA-G-1 for the overview module on capital adequacy; HKMA periodically consults on and revises individual modules.
formal_definition: A non-statutory supervisory manual issued by HKMA to Authorized Institutions under its general supervisory powers over banks; individual modules are referenced by an alphanumeric code (e.g. CA-G-1) and are periodically revised, sometimes following public consultation.
